items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: We had Martin Downey, Luther Guard.

ctx.x: Daddy used to play drums and everything at one time. And later on I played with Empty Daddy, little Teddy Miller. He had no legs.

And he used to come around and you know, push, what the hell you call it, I don't know. Tommy Harmon, who was with me. Oh man, he used to come around and tell them the clubs and you know, do a few numbers and they'd show him some tips. And I think he used to go in Royal and Canal and I was running. I was running. He comes down against me. I was with him sitting. We worked at the Piper Rock, two seasons. We had Martin Downey, Luther Guard. You know that guy, Lyman, he's talking about?
